What’s Dogecoin and how did it start?

Featuring the Shiba Inu dog from the viral “Doge” meme, Dogecoin started in 2013 as a joke by two Australian developers. 

They used the viral “Doge” Shiba Inu meme to poke fun at the crypto craze, never expecting it to have any real value.
